brief.t: START HERE: Open the Optiphen Plus COA with Ron/QC and Sam; resolve the document exception before treating it as cleared.

ACT NOW 1: Resolve the Optiphen Plus COA exception. Exception identified 2 days ago. Email's Oct31 visual document review flagged batch 0002751898-18586 acid value 5.9 versus 25–37.5 and phenol 29.7 ppm versus maximum 6. No resolution found in current searched sources. Not a proven failed lot, receipt or production block. Send internally: Ron and QC, please match this COA to our lot and resolve the conflicting results with Sam today before treating it as cleared.

ACT NOW 2: Match the existing seed-oil order to production. Michael and Evelyn's request is 3 days old. Existing NatureInBottle 5kg seed-oil order/payment notice has no verified dispatch or ETA in searched sources. Exact project, specification, usable stock and allocation remain unconfirmed. Talova49 lists berry/fruit oil0.227kg, not seed oil. Do not reorder or substitute. Send internally: Evelyn and Michael, please match the existing 5 kg seed-oil order to your project and specification, then confirm arrival needed and the production plan today.

ACT NOW 3: Protect the 9:30 AM sanitation call. Today's calendar confirms Ecolab9:30–10AM Eastern, overlapping Weekly Sync9:30–10:30; KWC/Ron follows at10AM. The conflict is today, not overdue. Katie is waiting for production/residue/current-cleaning details. Consultation is not sanitation clearance. Send internally: Michael, I am prioritizing the 9:30 Ecolab call; please cover Weekly Sync and send me the cleaning issues and current process before 9:15.
